summary: impact.com launched Contextual Ads, letting commerce publishers earn per click (CPC) alongside affiliate commissions, with Dianomi.
CJ published its Holiday Season Insights 2026 report, forecasting holiday sales above $1.4 trillion, and spoke at PI LIVE about LLM visibility.
Partnerize won four Global Performance Marketing Awards, and CJ won two.
Newegg went to YouTube Shopping's Holiday House for the second year running.

items.title: impact.com Adds CPC Contextual Ads for Commerce Publishers
items.why: Affiliate networks are adding pay-per-click income for publishers, a sign that commission alone isn't seen as enough to keep commerce content funded.
